verses.en: Why are the nations in an uproar? And why do the peoples mutter in vain?

verses.he: יִ֥תְיַצְּב֨וּ׀ מַלְכֵי־אֶ֗רֶץ וְרוֹזְנִ֥ים נֽוֹסְדוּ־יָ֑חַד עַל־יְ֝הוָה וְעַל־מְשִׁיחֽוֹ׃
verses.en: The kings of the earth stand up, And the rulers take counsel together, Against the LORD, and against His anointed:
'Let us break their bands asunder, And cast away their cords from us.'
He that sitteth in heaven laugheth, The Lord hath them in derision.

verses.he: אָ֤ז יְדַבֵּ֣ר אֵלֵ֣ימוֹ בְאַפּ֑וֹ וּֽבַחֲרוֹנ֥וֹ יְבַהֲלֵֽמוֹ׃
verses.en: Then will He speak unto them in His wrath, And affright them in His sore displeasure:
'Truly it is I that have established My king Upon Zion, My holy mountain.'

verses.he: אֲסַפְּרָ֗ה אֶֽ֫ל חֹ֥ק יְֽהוָ֗ה אָמַ֘ר אֵלַ֥י בְּנִ֥י אַ֑תָּה אֲ֝נִ֗י הַיּ֥וֹם יְלִדְתִּֽיךָ׃
verses.en: I will tell of the decree: The LORD said unto me: 'Thou art My son, This day have I begotten thee.

verses.he: שְׁאַ֤ל מִמֶּ֗נִּי וְאֶתְּנָ֣ה ג֭וֹיִם נַחֲלָתֶ֑ךָ וַ֝אֲחֻזָּתְךָ֗ אַפְסֵי־אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.en: Ask of Me, and I will give the nations for thine inheritance, And the ends of the earth for thy possession.

verses.he: תְּ֭רֹעֵם בְּשֵׁ֣בֶט בַּרְזֶ֑ל כִּכְלִ֖י יוֹצֵ֣ר תְּנַפְּצֵֽם׃
verses.en: Thou shalt break them with a rod of iron; Thou shalt dash them in pieces like a potter's vessel.'

verses.he: וְ֭עַתָּה מְלָכִ֣ים הַשְׂכִּ֑ילוּ הִ֝וָּסְר֗וּ שֹׁ֣פְטֵי אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.en: Now therefore, O ye kings, be wise; Be admonished, ye judges of the earth.
Serve the LORD with fear, And rejoice with trembling.

verses.he: נַשְּׁקוּ־בַ֡ר פֶּן־יֶאֱנַ֤ף׀ וְתֹ֬אבְדוּ דֶ֗רֶךְ כִּֽי־יִבְעַ֣ר כִּמְעַ֣ט אַפּ֑וֹ אַ֝שְׁרֵ֗י כָּל־ח֥וֹסֵי בֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Do homage in purity, lest He be angry, and ye perish in the way, When suddenly His wrath is kindled. Happy are all they that take refuge in Him.
